name: ESP32 Firmware Agent
install:
python3 -m pip install --user -U 'platformio' 'click>=8.0.4,<8.4'
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
pio --version
python3 tests/test_popse_contract.py
pio pkg install -e esp32dev
pio pkg install -e esp32-s3 || true
pio pkg install -e esp32-c3 || true
pio pkg install -e lilygo-t-display-s3 || true
